Our process

From the first conversation
to the next chapter.

01 / Understand

Start with the people involved. We listen to the owner’s priorities and the acquirer’s requirements, including what each wants to preserve.

02 / Structure

Define the preferred stake, timing, strategic fit and terms that will guide the search.

03 / Originate

Identify suitable businesses or counterparties, qualify the fit and agree what can be shared.

04 / Execute

Coordinate introductions, negotiations and diligence alongside the parties and their professional advisers.

05 / Transition

Support the handover of relationships, responsibilities and operating knowledge to the next owner.

Not every entrepreneur needs to start from zero.

Not every business needs to end with its founder.

Not every investor needs to build from scratch.

Sometimes, the greatest opportunity is already built.
